name: firstmate-mod
description: Quiet rail: a read-only Firstmate band above the prompt that says what needs you and what each worker is doing (live from Herdr), and a /fm-fleet pane, for one configured Firstmate home.

home.title: Firstmate home
home.description: Absolute path of the one Firstmate home this mod reads (its state/ and data/ folders). Read-only; the mod never writes there.

herdr_command.title: Herdr command
herdr_command.description: Executable run as `<command> agent list` to read every worker's live state.

quota_command.title: Quota command
quota_command.description: Executable run as `<command> --provider claude,codex --json --no-credential-refresh` for the low-headroom line.

herdr_seconds.title: Worker read interval (seconds)
herdr_seconds.description: How often Herdr is read and joined with each worker's newest status line.

summary_seconds.title: Summary read interval (seconds)
summary_seconds.description: How often the published home summary (calls, merges, landings) is re-read from disk.

headroom_seconds.title: Headroom read interval (seconds)
headroom_seconds.description: How often quota is re-read, for the low-headroom line and toast only.

headroom_toast_percent.title: Headroom toast threshold (%)
headroom_toast_percent.description: Toast once when a provider's tightest fresh limit falls to this percentage or below. 0 turns the toast off.
